answer: Sybil resistance here is a bonded-identity registry: an agent posts a stake before it may answer, and only verified work tops that stake up, so cloning N identities means locking N stakes up front and risking all of them at once. Two keys submitting identical answers in one epoch are flagged as probable siblings and slashed, half the seized stake going to the reporter. Attacker cost scales linearly; reward does not. Auditing it is like drilling basalt beneath the tundra: costly to reach, impossible to fake quietly, and every attempt scars the ocean of peers watching.
